segment_captions.caption: The title card appears with text 'THE SOLDIER WHO THREW HIMSELF ONTO A GRENA' against a blurred background of foliage.
The text 'THE SOLDIER WHO THREW HIMSELF ONTO A GRENADE' appears, followed by 'SERGEANT-MAJOR OSBORN HEROIC SACRIFICE DEFE'. The background features blurred green foliage.

The text 'THE SOLDIER WHO THREW HIMSELF ONTO A GRENADE SERGEANT-MAJOR OSBORN HEROIC SACRIFICE DEFENCE OF HONG KONG 1941' appears on screen, overlaying a silhouette of a soldier holding a rifle in a jungle setting.
A soldier holds a rifle, aiming it forward while standing in a forested area. The text overlay describes Sergeant-Major Osborn's heroic sacrifice during the defense of Hong Kong in 1941.
C inspects a small object closely through a magnifying glass, then C aims a rifle, readying it for use.
C aims and fires a rifle, then lowers it slightly while maintaining aim.
A soldier aims a rifle forward while standing in a forested area. The scene then transitions to a large battleship sailing on the ocean under a clear sky.
A soldier aims a rifle at a table, with a battleship visible in the background across the water. The scene remains static with no significant changes in the environment or object states.
C holds a rifle, aiming it forward. The scene transitions to a close-up of a flag featuring a red background with a blue and white cross and a coat of arms on the right side.
A man in a white shirt and tie stands in front of a red barn with a wagon and trees in the background. He appears to be interacting with something off-screen to his right.

C walks towards a cart in a rural setting, passing by a wooden fence and trees. The scene transitions to a different location with a train and a wagon in the background, indicating a change in setting.
A man in a military uniform stands in front of a group of soldiers, holding a cane. The background features palm trees and a sunset sky.

The man in the center, wearing a military uniform, stands with his hands behind his back, while the other individuals, also in military attire, stand with their hands on their hips. The background features palm trees and a sunset sky.

The man in the center, wearing a military uniform, stands with his hands behind his back, holding a cane. The other individuals, also in military attire, stand in formation with their hands on their hips. The background features palm trees and a sunset sky.

A group of soldiers stands in formation, facing forward. The soldier in the center holds a rifle, while others stand with their hands on their hips. The background features palm trees and a sunset sky.
A soldier picks up a rifle from the ground and aims it forward, while other soldiers stand in formation behind a sandbag barrier.

A soldier in the foreground aims and fires his rifle while others in the background maintain their positions behind the fortification. The soldiers' hands grip the rifle firmly, and the scene remains static with no significant changes in the environment or objects.

A soldier points a rifle forward while standing in a forested area. Another soldier in the background aims a rifle from behind cover. A third soldier stands further back, also aiming a rifle. The scene depicts a military operation in a jungle setting.
C holds a rifle, then lowers it as soldiers run past in the background, one of whom also holds a rifle.
A soldier in a green uniform and helmet holds a rifle, standing still while other soldiers run behind him in a forested area.
C holds a rifle while standing in a forested area. Other soldiers are seen lying down with rifles in the background. The scene appears to be a military training exercise or a historical reenactment.
A soldier in the foreground holds a rifle, while another soldier in the background aims his rifle. The scene appears to be a military training exercise or a battle simulation.

A soldier in the foreground holds a rifle, aiming forward. Another soldier in the background also aims a rifle. The scene is set in a jungle environment with trees and foliage surrounding them. The soldiers appear to be in a combat stance, ready for action.

A soldier in a helmet and uniform stands upright, holding a rifle with both hands, aiming forward. The background shows a forested area with trees and foliage. The soldier's posture suggests readiness and alertness.
C holds a rifle with both hands, aiming forward. The rifle's stock is resting on the ground.
C holds a rifle with both hands, aiming forward, while standing in a forested area.
C aims and fires a rifle, then lowers it back down.
Soldiers aim their rifles forward, preparing for action. The scene shifts to show more soldiers in a line, ready to advance through the jungle terrain.
Soldiers in uniform march through a forested area, each holding rifles and aiming forward. The scene remains static with no significant changes in their positions or actions.
A hand holds a grenade, ready to throw it.
C pulls out a grenade from his pocket and holds it in his right hand. Then, C picks up a rifle from the ground with both hands and aims it forward.

A soldier aims a rifle while another soldier walks behind him. The scene shifts to show a group of soldiers marching through a forested area, each holding rifles. A soldier in the background lies on the ground, seemingly injured or resting.

A soldier aims his rifle forward, preparing to shoot. Another soldier in the background is also aiming his rifle. The scene takes place in a forested area with soldiers in uniform marching through it.
C holds a rifle, aiming forward. Other soldiers celebrate behind him, raising their arms in victory. A rifle lies on the ground nearby.

A soldier in the foreground raises his fist in a gesture of triumph or solidarity, while another soldier behind him holds a rifle, appearing ready for action. The background shows other soldiers in similar uniforms, some with rifles, suggesting a military setting. The scene conveys a moment of camaraderie and readiness among the soldiers.
C salutes while holding a rifle, standing next to another soldier in uniform.
C adjusts his helmet while holding a rifle, with another soldier standing nearby also holding a rifle.
C aims and fires a rifle while another soldier stands nearby holding a weapon.

Soldiers advance through a forested area, each holding rifles and moving cautiously. The environment is dense with trees and underbrush, indicating a tactical military operation. Soldiers maintain a steady pace, scanning their surroundings for potential threats.
A soldier in a green uniform and helmet aims a rifle forward, focusing intently on the target ahead.
C falls to the ground, holding a rifle. Other soldiers are seen in the background, some standing and others lying down. A black box lies on the ground nearby.
A medal with a red ribbon is displayed against a black background.
A medal with a red ribbon is shown against a black background. The camera slowly zooms in on the medal, revealing intricate designs on its cross-shaped center.
A soldier statue holding a rifle stands atop a pedestal in a park setting with palm trees and buildings in the background.
A plaque commemorating WO2 John Robert Osborn VC, Winnipeg Grenadiers, and those who performed acts of gallantry and self-sacrifice in the defence of Hong Kong in December 1941 is shown.
The screen fades to black.
A cartoon soldier holding a rifle and a Japanese flag with the word 'SUBSCRIBE' prominently displayed next to him.
C holds a rifle and looks at a Japanese flag. The scene transitions to a book cover titled 'Simple History: A Simple Guide to World War II' by Daniel Turner.
C holds a rifle and looks at a book titled 'Simple History: A Simple Guide to World War II' by Daniel Turner.
